# Freshly started Traefik: entrypoint counters registered but no requests
# routed yet, and no service registered at all (no retries/server-up series).
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_requests_total How many HTTP requests processed on an entrypoint, partitioned by status code, protocol, and method.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_requests_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 0
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds How long it took to process the request on an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds histogram
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="0.1"} 0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http",le="+Inf"} 0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_sum{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 0
traefik_entrypoint_request_duration_seconds_count{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 0
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total The total size of requests in bytes handled by an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_requests_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 0
# HELP traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total The total size of responses in bytes handled by an entrypoint.
# TYPE traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total counter
traefik_entrypoint_responses_bytes_total{code="200",entrypoint="web",method="GET",protocol="http"} 0
